description: KiwiRail publishes kilometre posts or pegs used to locate positions along its railway network. Each point contains a kilometre reference and line name or code. Points are placed on the track centreline parallel to the physical peg, and adjacent pegs need not be exactly 1,000 or 500 metres apart. The inventory is incomplete and desktop-derived locations have not all been field verified. Feature-service and WFS listings are access alternatives. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service and alternate item listings. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
